name: How do I choose the right contractor for window sash repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for window sash repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for window sash repair, look for experience with various window types and materials, especially if you have older or unique windows. Check for proper licensing and insurance. Request references or review past projects to assess their quality of work and customer satisfaction. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed, written estimate after an on-site assessment, clearly outlining the scope of work, materials, and costs without pressure. Local contractors familiar with Bay Area homes are often a good choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with relevant experience and good references. Get a detailed, written estimate after an on-site assessment.
